SIMD kernels for the archive library, mirroring ports/nbrotli/simd.nim.

Enabled with clue build --features:nimsimd (or -d:features.archive.nimsimd). amd64 builds add -mavx2/-msse4.2, so a feature build requires a CPU with AVX2 + SSE4.2; without the feature everything falls back to scalar code and the binary runs anywhere. arm64 falls back to scalar copy/CRC for now.

Consts

hasAvx2 = false
simdOn = false
